title.narrative: Sustainable Development through improved Local Governance (SDLG) Programme

description.narrative:
The Strategic Partnership between the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs and VNG International is a 5-year programme, focused on 4 thematic priorities: Security & Rule of Law, Migration, Local Revenue Mobilisation, and Integrated Water Management. This programme called the Sustainable Development through improved Local Governance (SDLG) programme, is currently being implemented in countries (Benin, Burundi, Ethiopia, Kenya, Lebanon, Mali, Palestina, Somalia, South Sudan, Uganda, Iraq, Ukraine and Mozambique).
Despite the diverging contexts and themes, the SDLG programme pursues one overall objective: To empower local governments and their representative bodies to shape a more sustainable future for their communities.
